Since you enjoy robust Venezuelan arepas and grilled corn cakes, here are a few ways to lighten up those favorites without sacrificing flavor:

*   **Arepas:** Instead of traditionally filling arepas with generous amounts of cheese and meat, try using smaller portions of leaner proteins like shredded chicken breast or black beans. Load up on flavorful, low-calorie additions like sautéed onions, peppers, and fresh herbs. You could also experiment with whole wheat flour for the arepa dough to increase fiber.
*   **Grilled Corn Cakes:** These are already a great base! Focus on lighter toppings. Instead of creamy sauces or high-fat cheeses, consider salsa, pico de gallo, grilled vegetables, or a sprinkle of cotija cheese (which has a stronger flavor, so you need less). A squeeze of lime juice can also add a lot of brightness and flavor.
